LanguageData.CC_Name_Settings_Epithets_Tip: Whoever has done the most of something (tended wounds, killed raiders, cleaned messes, caught fire) earns a name for it. A name holds: it passes to someone else only when they clearly outdo the holder over a whole season, and each colonist is known by one name.
LanguageData.CC_Name_PageSub: What the colony is known for and how far its name carries: its ways, what its work has made it, its renown and what each people remembers.
LanguageData.CC_Name_PeopleSub: The name each of the colony's people is known by, at home and beyond its walls, and what the others say of them.
LanguageData.CC_Name_PeopleNone: Nobody of the colony is known by a name yet. The colony gives one for steady work it sees; a contest won, a ward fostered well, a camp broken or a people's wounded tended carries one beyond its walls.
